title: Asur Season 3 Begins Shooting With Arshad Warsi and Barun Sobti, Eyes Mid-2027 Premiere
excerpt: India's acclaimed mythological thriller returns with its original leads plus new additions Ahsaas Channa and Shweta Basu Prasad, as creator Gaurav Shukla steps behind the camera for the first time.
body:
• Asur Season 3 began shooting on August 30 in Mumbai, with production expected to wrap by December 2026 and a mid-2027 premiere targeted on JioHotstar
  • Arshad Warsi and Barun Sobti return as forensic experts Dhananjay Rajput and Nikhil Nair, joined by new cast members Ahsaas Channa and Shweta Basu Prasad
  • Creator and lead writer Gaurav Shukla takes over as director from Oni Sen, who helmed the first two seasons and is currently working on Netflix India's Operation Safed Sagar
  • The new season promises to expand the franchise in scale and narrative ambition while retaining its signature blend of mythology and psychological suspense

Cameras Roll in Mumbai

One of India's most popular streaming series is officially back in production. Asur Season 3 began shooting on August 30 in Mumbai, nearly three years after the second season premiered in 2023 to widespread acclaim and emerged as one of the most-watched Indian series of that year.

https://x.com/Bollyhungama/status/2095768832501542920

Arshad Warsi and Barun Sobti are returning to reprise their fan-favorite roles as forensic experts Dhananjay Rajput and Nikhil Nair, the duo whose chemistry has anchored the series since its debut in 2020. Also returning are Ridhi Dogra, Anupriya Goenka, and Vishesh Bansal, ensuring continuity with the ensemble that drove the first two seasons.

Production is scheduled to film across multiple cities over the next three months, with the makers targeting a wrap by December 2026. The series will stream on JioHotstar, with a mid-2027 premiere window, according to exclusive reports from Bollywood Hungama.

Fresh Faces Join the Cast

The new season brings several notable additions to the ensemble. Ahsaas Channa, known for her work in Girls Hostel, Kota Factory, and Hostel Daze, has joined the cast and has already begun shooting.

"I am beyond thrilled to join Asur 3, especially after being one of the biggest fans of the show. It feels surreal to have this opportunity to work alongside some of the most talented actors, including Arshad Warsi sir, Barun Sobti and Ridhi Dogra."

— Ahsaas Channa, Actor

Shweta Basu Prasad, the National Award-winning actress whose career spans from the iconic Makdee to recent streaming projects, has also been cast in a pivotal role. Details about both characters are being kept under wraps.

A Major Shift Behind the Camera

The most significant change in Asur Season 3 comes on the creative front. Oni Sen, who directed the first two seasons, will not be returning. Sen is currently riding the success of Netflix India's Operation Safed Sagar and has moved on to other projects.

Taking over the directorial reins is Gaurav Shukla, Asur's creator and lead writer, who will make his directorial debut with the new season. Shukla's writing credits include Angrezi Medium, The Girl on the Train, and Saare Jahan Se Accha. He has spent the intervening years since Season 2 developing the new season and is believed to have crafted a story that expands the franchise in both scale and narrative ambition.

Shukla will co-direct with Shwetabh Varma, an ad filmmaker known for his stylized campaigns for brands including JK Cement WallMaxX, Domino's, and Yamaha. The pairing of a first-time feature director with a seasoned visual stylist from the advertising world suggests a season that may push the show's visual language into new territory.

What Made Asur a Streaming Phenomenon

Asur follows a team of forensic experts caught in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with a serial killer who believes himself to be an incarnation of the mythological demon Kali. The series earned praise for its unusual approach — blending Hindu mythology with forensic procedural storytelling and psychological suspense in a way that felt genuinely distinctive in Indian streaming content.

The first season, which premiered on Voot Select in March 2020, became a cult hit during the early months of the pandemic. Season 2, released on JioCinema in 2023, expanded the mythology and deepened the psychological conflicts between its leads, emerging as one of the year's most-watched Indian series.

Streaming Reach for NRI Audiences

For Indian diaspora viewers in the US, UK, and beyond, Asur has been one of the breakout Indian streaming shows that transcended regional boundaries. The series' availability on JioHotstar's international platform means NRI audiences will have access to Season 3 upon release. The show's blend of mythological depth and contemporary thriller mechanics has resonated particularly well with younger diaspora viewers who grew up straddling both cultural worlds.

The third season promises to retain the show's core DNA while pushing into darker and more layered territory, with heightened psychological conflicts, deeper explorations of Indian mythology, and a fresh perspective on the eternal struggle between chaos and order. With Shukla now controlling both the writing and direction, the creative vision for Season 3 will be more unified than ever.
